title: Rezon becomes king over Aram
description: God raised up Rezon, son of Eliada, as an adversary against Solomon. Rezon had fled from his master Hadadezer, king of Zobah, and gathered a band of raiders around him after David had defeated them. They went to Damascus, settled there, and Rezon became king over Aram. He was an adversary of Israel throughout all the days of Solomon and hated Israel [ref:1 Kings 11:23-25|1 Kings 11:23-25].
